verdict.rationale: Twenty documents REST and GraphQL batching of up to 60 records per request, with batch upsert on GraphQL only (twenty-docs-25). Outbound webhooks fire on record create, update and delete, which covers change detection (twenty-docs-62). API import is listed as unlimited for large-scale migrations and automation (twenty-docs-59), and one community user reports the REST API 'worked ok' (twenty-comm-1). missing for 10: documented API rate limits, upsert on the REST API, incremental change queries or a cursor/delta feed for polling-based sync, and independent evidence of bidirectional sync at scale.
